proof_body:
by
  intro R _ x n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have shift : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n : R) * (Nat.stirlingFirst n k : R)) * x ^ k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n : R) * (Nat.stirlingFirst n (k + 1) : R)) * x ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ _ n, Nat.stirlingFirst_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
      cases n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ m => simp
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (n + 1), Nat.stirlingFirst_succ_zero]
    simp only [Nat.stirlingFirst_succ_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, add_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← shift, Finset.sum_mul, add_comm]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    ring
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (x : R) (n : ℕ), ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x + (i : R)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.stirlingFirst n k : R) * x ^ k
